```{r annotation_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# 读取 Peak 并注释
# 由于参考基因组可能使用 Ensembl 格式 (1, 2...) 而 TxDb 使用 UCSC 格式 (chr1, chr2...)，需要转换
read_and_fix_peak <- function(file) {
  peak <- readPeakFile(file)
  # 如果染色体名不以 chr 开头，则添加 chr 前缀
  if(!any(grepl("^chr", seqlevels(peak)))) {
    new_seqlevels <- paste0("chr", seqlevels(peak))
    # 修正线粒体: chrMT -> chrM
    new_seqlevels <- sub("chrMT", "chrM", new_seqlevels)
    seqlevels(peak) <- new_seqlevels
  }
  
  # 仅保留标准染色体 (chr1-19, chrX, chrY)
  standard_chr <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))
  peak <- peak[seqnames(peak) %in% standard_chr]
  seqlevels(peak) <- seqlevelsInUse(peak)
  
  return(peak)
}

peaks_list <- lapply(peak_files, read_and_fix_peak)

# --- 按 reads_info 定义的组别合并 Peak ---
peaks_by_group <- stats::setNames(lapply(group_levels, function(group_name) {
  group_samples <- sample_manifest$sample[sample_manifest$group == group_name]
  group_peak_list <- peaks_list[group_samples]
  if(length(group_peak_list) == 0) return(GenomicRanges::GRanges())
  reduce(do.call(c, unname(group_peak_list)))
}), group_levels)

# 按组别注释
peakAnnoList <- lapply(peaks_list, annotatePeak, TxDb=txdb, 
                       tssRegion=c(-2000, 2000), verbose=FALSE, 
                       annoDb="org.Mm.eg.db")

peakAnnoByGroup <- lapply(peaks_by_group, annotatePeak, TxDb=txdb, 
                          tssRegion=c(-2000, 2000), verbose=FALSE, 
                          annoDb="org.Mm.eg.db")

# 按组别汇总 feature 注释，并沿用 WGBS 报告的 feature 配色
annotation_by_group_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(peakAnnoByGroup), function(group_name) {
  as.data.frame(peakAnnoByGroup[[group_name]]) %>%
    transmute(
      Group = group_name,
      annotation,
      annotation_simple = normalize_feature_label(annotation)
    )
}))
write.csv(annotation_by_group_df, step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_Annotation_Detail_By_Group.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

annotation_summary <- annotation_by_group_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Group, annotation_simple, name = "PeakCount") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels),
    annotation_simple = factor(annotation_simple, levels = feature_levels_main)
  ) %>%

write.csv(annotation_summary, step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_Annotation_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

feature_cols <- resolve_named_colors(
  feature_levels_main,

  fallback_colors = viz_pal$feature_accent,
  default_color = viz_pal$neutral_mid
)

p_anno <- ggplot(annotation_summary, aes(x = Group, y = Fraction, fill = annotation_simple)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, color = scales::alpha(viz_pal$neutral_dark, 0.2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = feature_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Feature") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  theme_atac_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Peak Annotation Composition by Group",

}
```

```{r peak_sample_distributions, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
sample_peak_annotation_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(peakAnnoList), function(sample_name) {

  anno_df %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = sample_name,

      geneId = if("geneId" %in% colnames(anno_df)) geneId else NA_character_,

    )

read_macs2_peak_xls <- function(sample_name) {
  xls_file <- file.path(work_dir, "03peaks", paste0(sample_name, "_peaks.xls"))
  if(!file.exists(xls_file)) return(data.frame())
  peak_tbl <- tryCatch(
    read.delim(xls_file, comment.char = "#", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
    error = function(e) data.frame()
  )
  if(nrow(peak_tbl) == 0) return(data.frame())
  for(required_col in c("chr", "start", "end", "length", "pileup", "fold_enrichment", "-log10(pvalue)", "-log10(qvalue)")) {
    if(!required_col %in% colnames(peak_tbl)) peak_tbl[[required_col]] <- NA
  }
  peak_tbl %>%
    transmute(
      Sample = sample_name,
      Group = sample_group(sample_name),
      chr = chr,
      start = suppressWarnings(as.integer(start)),
      end = suppressWarnings(as.integer(end)),
      length = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(length)),
      pileup = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pileup)),
      fold_enrichment = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fold_enrichment)),
      neg_log10_pvalue = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["-log10(pvalue)"]])),
      neg_log10_qvalue = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[["-log10(qvalue)"]]))
    )
}

macs2_peak_signal_df <- bind_rows(lapply(samples, read_macs2_peak_xls))
```

```{r upset_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# --- 高级图表: UpSet Plot 展示 Peak 重叠 ---

# 定义一个共有区域集合 (将所有 Peak 合并并 reduce)
all_peaks <- Reduce(c, peaks_list)
all_peaks <- reduce(all_peaks)

# 按组别展示重叠 (Reference vs Comparison)
overlap_by_group <- sapply(peaks_by_group, function(p) {
  ov <- findOverlaps(all_peaks, p)
  res <- rep(0, length(all_peaks))
  res[queryHits(ov)] <- 1
  return(res)
})
overlap_by_group_df <- as.data.frame(overlap_by_group)
write.csv(overlap_by_group_df, step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_Overlap_Membership.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# 绘制按组别的 UpSet Plot
draw_upset_dual(
  step_plot_file("Step4", "Peak_UpSet.pdf"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  print(atac_plot_peak_upset(overlap_by_group_df))
)

# 在 Rmd 中显示
print(atac_plot_peak_upset(overlap_by_group_df))

group_a <- group_levels[1]
group_b <- group_levels[2]
group_a_only <- sum(overlap_by_group_df[[group_a]] == 1 & overlap_by_group_df[[group_b]] == 0)
group_b_only <- sum(overlap_by_group_df[[group_a]] == 0 & overlap_by_group_df[[group_b]] == 1)
shared <- sum(overlap_by_group_df[[group_a]] == 1 & overlap_by_group_df[[group_b]] == 1)
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Group1 = group_a,
    Group2 = group_b,
    Group1_only = group_a_only,
    Group2_only = group_b_only,
    Shared = shared
  ),
  step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_Overlap_Summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat("\n组间 Peak 重叠统计:\n")
cat(" ", group_a, "特有 Peaks:", group_a_only, "\n")
cat(" ", group_b, "特有 Peaks:", group_b_only, "\n")
cat("  共有 Peaks:", shared, "\n")
```

```{r advanced_peak_plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
tss_profile_df <- data.frame(
  Group = character(),
  position = numeric(),
  signal = numeric(),
  baseline = numeric(),
  signal_fold_over_flank = numeric(),
  signal_centered = numeric(),
  signal_zscore = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if(!should_render_plots()) {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step4",
    "Peak_Advanced_Profile_Plots",
    "Run profile does not request heavy plots; ChIPseeker covplot and getTagMatrix TSS profile were skipped for report-mode speed.",
    clear_plot_files = c("Peak_Chrom_Distribution.pdf", "Peak_TSS_Profile.pdf")
  )
  write.csv(tss_profile_df, step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_TSS_Profile_Data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  # --- 高级图表 1: 染色体分布图 (Covplot) ---
  group_colors <- viz_pal$group

  p_cov <- covplot(peaks_by_group) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12, legend = "top") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
    ggtitle("Peak Distribution across Chromosomes by Group")

  save_gg_dual(step_plot_file("Step4", "Peak_Chrom_Distribution.pdf"), p_cov, width = 12, height = 12)
  print(p_cov)

  # --- 高级图表 2: TSS 附近的 Peak 结合谱 (Average Profile) ---
  promoter <- getPromoters(TxDb=txdb, upstream=2000, downstream=2000)
  tagMatrixByGroup <- lapply(peaks_by_group, getTagMatrix, windows=promoter)

  tss_profile_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(tagMatrixByGroup), function(group_name) {
    mat <- tagMatrixByGroup[[group_name]]
    if(is.null(mat) || ncol(mat) == 0) return(data.frame())
    positions <- seq(-2000, 2000, length.out = ncol(mat))
    raw_signal <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    normalized_signal <- normalize_tss_profile(raw_signal, positions = positions, flank_abs_min = 1500)
    data.frame(
      Group = group_name,
      position = positions,
      signal = raw_signal,
      baseline = normalized_signal$baseline,
      signal_fold_over_flank = normalized_signal$signal_fold_over_flank,
      signal_centered = normalized_signal$signal_centered,
      signal_zscore = normalized_signal$signal_zscore,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  write.csv(tss_profile_df, step_table_file("Step4", "Peak_TSS_Profile_Data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  p_tss_profile <- ggplot(tss_profile_df, aes(x = position, y = signal_fold_over_flank, color = Group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.45, color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = viz_pal$group) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "Average TSS accessibility profile",
      subtitle = "Signal is normalized to the mean flanking baseline (|distance| >= 1.5 kb)",
      x = "Distance to TSS (bp)",
      y = "Fold over flank baseline",
      color = "Group"
    )

  save_plot_pdf(p_tss_profile, step_plot_file("Step4", "Peak_TSS_Profile.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
  print(p_tss_profile)
}
```

```{r deeptools_profiles}
run_deeptools_profiles <- env_bool("ATAC_RUN_DEEPTOOLS_PROFILES", run_profile == "full")
deeptools_bins <- c(computeMatrix = Sys.which("computeMatrix"), plotProfile = Sys.which("plotProfile"), plotHeatmap = Sys.which("plotHeatmap"))
deeptools_bw_files <- unname(bigwig_files)
names(deeptools_bw_files) <- samples
deeptools_profile_summary <- data.frame()

if(!run_deeptools_profiles) {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step4",
    "deepTools_Profile",
    "ATAC_RUN_DEEPTOOLS_PROFILES is false; gene body and peak-center deepTools profiles were not executed.",
    clear_plot_files = c(
      "GeneBody_Profile.pdf",
      "GeneBody_Heatmap.pdf",
      "PeakCenter_Profile.pdf",
      "PeakCenter_Heatmap.pdf"
    )
  )
} else if(any(!nzchar(deeptools_bins)) || !all(file.exists(deeptools_bw_files))) {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step4",
    "deepTools_Profile",
    paste(
      "Missing deepTools executables or sample bigWig files.",
      "computeMatrix=", nzchar(deeptools_bins["computeMatrix"]),
      "plotProfile=", nzchar(deeptools_bins["plotProfile"]),
      "plotHeatmap=", nzchar(deeptools_bins["plotHeatmap"]),
      "bigWigs=", paste(names(deeptools_bw_files)[file.exists(deeptools_bw_files)], collapse = ",")
    ),
    clear_plot_files = c(
      "GeneBody_Profile.pdf",
      "GeneBody_Heatmap.pdf",
      "PeakCenter_Profile.pdf",
      "PeakCenter_Heatmap.pdf"
    )
  )
} else {
  gene_regions <- genes(txdb)
  seqlevelsStyle(gene_regions) <- "UCSC"
  gene_regions <- keep_primary_chromosomes(gene_regions)
  gene_bed <- as.data.frame(gene_regions) %>%
    transmute(
      seqnames = as.character(seqnames),
      start = pmax(0L, as.integer(start) - 1L),
      end = as.integer(end),
      name = if("gene_id" %in% colnames(as.data.frame(gene_regions))) as.character(gene_id) else paste0("Gene_", seq_len(n())),
      score = 0,
      strand = as.character(strand)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(seqnames), !is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start)

  peak_center_gr <- if(exists("all_peaks") && length(all_peaks) > 0) {
    keep_primary_chromosomes(all_peaks)
  } else {
    keep_primary_chromosomes(reduce(Reduce(c, peaks_list)))
  }
  peak_center_bed <- as.data.frame(peak_center_gr) %>%
    transmute(
      seqnames = as.character(seqnames),
      start = pmax(0L, as.integer(start) - 1L),
      end = as.integer(end),
      name = paste0("Peak_", seq_len(n())),
      score = 0,
      strand = "."
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(seqnames), !is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start)

  gene_bed_file <- step_table_file("Step4", "GeneBody_Regions.bed")
  peak_bed_file <- step_table_file("Step4", "PeakCenter_Regions.bed")
  write.table(gene_bed, gene_bed_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(peak_center_bed, peak_bed_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

  run_deeptools_set <- function(label, matrix_mode, region_file, matrix_file, profile_pdf, heatmap_pdf) {
    if(!file.exists(region_file) || file.info(region_file)$size == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Profile = label, Status = "skipped", Reason = "empty region BED", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    if(matrix_mode == "scale-regions") {
      matrix_args <- c(
        "scale-regions", "-S", unname(deeptools_bw_files), "-R", region_file,
        "-b", "2000", "-a", "2000", "--missingDataAsZero", "--skipZeros",
        "-p", "max/2", "-out", matrix_file
      )
    } else {
      matrix_args <- c(
        "reference-point", "--referencePoint", "center", "-S", unname(deeptools_bw_files), "-R", region_file,
        "-b", "2000", "-a", "2000", "--missingDataAsZero", "--skipZeros",
        "-p", "max/2", "-out", matrix_file
      )
    }
    matrix_status <- system2(deeptools_bins["computeMatrix"], matrix_args,
                             stdout = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_computeMatrix.log")),
                             stderr = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_computeMatrix.err")))
    if(!identical(matrix_status, 0L) && !identical(matrix_status, 0)) {
      return(data.frame(Profile = label, Status = "failed", Reason = "computeMatrix failed", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
    profile_status <- system2(deeptools_bins["plotProfile"],
                              c("-m", matrix_file, "-out", profile_pdf, "--perGroup", "--plotTitle", label),
                              stdout = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_plotProfile.log")),
                              stderr = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_plotProfile.err")))
    heatmap_status <- system2(deeptools_bins["plotHeatmap"],
                              c("-m", matrix_file, "-out", heatmap_pdf, "--plotTitle", label,
                                "--colorList", paste(unname(viz_pal$heatmap_diverging), collapse = ",")),
                              stdout = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_plotHeatmap.log")),
                              stderr = step_table_file("Step4", paste0(label, "_plotHeatmap.err")))
    data.frame(
      Profile = label,
      Status = ifelse(identical(profile_status, 0L) || identical(profile_status, 0), "profile_ok", "profile_failed"),
      HeatmapStatus = ifelse(identical(heatmap_status, 0L) || identical(heatmap_status, 0), "heatmap_ok", "heatmap_failed"),
      Matrix = matrix_file,
      ProfilePlot = profile_pdf,
      HeatmapPlot = heatmap_pdf,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  deeptools_profile_summary <- bind_rows(
    run_deeptools_set(
      "GeneBody_Profile",
      "scale-regions",
      gene_bed_file,
      step_table_file("Step4", "GeneBody_Matrix.gz"),
      step_plot_file("Step4", "GeneBody_Profile.pdf"),
      step_plot_file("Step4", "GeneBody_Heatmap.pdf")
    ),
    run_deeptools_set(
      "PeakCenter_Profile",
      "reference-point",
      peak_bed_file,
      step_table_file("Step4", "PeakCenter_Matrix.gz"),
      step_plot_file("Step4", "PeakCenter_Profile.pdf"),
      step_plot_file("Step4", "PeakCenter_Heatmap.pdf")
    )
  )
  save_step_table(deeptools_profile_summary, "Step4", "deepTools_Profile_Summary.csv")
}
```
